comparison.objective: Loosen two media-bottle caps before placing their basket in an autoclave.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize a safety prerequisite, rotate both caps, then push the basket into the chamber.
comparison.success_condition: Both caps loosened before full insertion; inserting a sealed bottle latches failure.
comparison.reason: This is procedural safety with screw-cap rotation and basket placement. The complete record has no spec versions, but its objective and staged scoring clearly differ from impact fracture and fragment recovery.
